description: DEMO ONLY: made-up loop tasks for the full-grid stub replay (Docs/v1.3/grid-scale-replay.md). Not study tasks and not pilot tasks; the Study 2 tasks are sealed elsewhere and were never read.

steps.request: Create a todo list service: create and list todos, kept in memory.
Add tags to the todo list service and list them per item.
Add due dates to the todo list service; keep them in a store.
Add reminders to the todo list service and list the latest ones.
Add archive to the todo list service and show a summary of them.
Create a recipe box service: create and list recipes, kept in memory.
Add ingredients to the recipe box service and list them per item.
Add ratings to the recipe box service; keep them in a store.
Add shopping lists to the recipe box service and list the latest ones.
Add collections to the recipe box service and show a summary of them.
Create a book club service: create and list members, kept in memory.
Add books to the book club service and list them per item.
Add meetings to the book club service; keep them in a store.
Add votes to the book club service and list the latest ones.
Add reading notes to the book club service and show a summary of them.
Create a gym log service: create and list workouts, kept in memory.
Add exercises to the gym log service and list them per item.
Add personal bests to the gym log service; keep them in a store.
Add plans to the gym log service and list the latest ones.
Add streaks to the gym log service and show a summary of them.
Create a plant care service: create and list plants, kept in memory.
Add watering to the plant care service and list them per item.
Add rooms to the plant care service; keep them in a store.
Add fertiliser to the plant care service and list the latest ones.
Add care notes to the plant care service and show a summary of them.
Create a chore chart service: create and list chores, kept in memory.
Add household to the chore chart service and list them per item.
Add rotation to the chore chart service; keep them in a store.
Add points to the chore chart service and list the latest ones.
Add rewards to the chore chart service and show a summary of them.
